purpose: Frozen Arm-0 reference config for Mind2Web target-discrimination validation. See docs/stage9-mind2web-validation.md.

pooled_stat_path.note: DoG-reconstructed sampling path. Not the MIP fallback (sampleMIPPooled at line 628). file_blob_sha is the git blob SHA (git hash-object) — any edit to the file invalidates it. signature_prefix is grepped from the live file at the pinned line to catch function renames and signature changes. Step 3 wires the capability-detect branch to throw if MIP fallback is silently substituted at runtime.

modes_json_drift_pin.note: Blob SHA of shared/modes.json at freeze. validateLive() re-reads the file and compares. Catches the mode-15-style silent drift where pipeline knobs are edited without updating the Arm-0 snapshot.

pixel_source.description: Per-action page state captured with Playwright Page.captureSnapshot. MHTML is Chromium's single-file bundle (HTML + CSS + images + fonts base64-inlined). Loaded into Electron BrowserView via file:// URL; Chromium rehydrates the full styled page with a live DOM. Arm-0 samples the peripheral shader's output over those pixels; Arm-1 additionally uses the live DOM for renderer/preload.js primitive classification. Canonical pixel source as of v3 pivot — see memo §Pixel-source pivot for history of v1 (naked-DOM, broken) and v2 (Multimodal screenshot, correct pixels but no DOM) predecessors.
pixel_source.viability_tested_on: united.com task 401c4e6f, actions 1 (combobox) and 4 (calendar). On action 1 (N=5 same-type distractors), v3 AUC = v2 AUC = 0.800 exactly. On action 4 (N=262 calendar cells), divergence of ~0.4 AUC reveals pathological-UI failure mode (see pathological_ui_filter).
pixel_source.bbox_space_authority: bounding_box_rect values in Multimodal-Mind2Web raw_html attributes are authoritative against the MHTML render at 1280-wide viewport. Scrutinizer's BrowserView window is sized to viewport.viewport_w exactly; no reflow.

metadata_source.used_for: bboxes (bounding_box_rect attrs in raw_html), pos_candidates, neg_candidates, action metadata, action_uid → MHTML filename lookup
metadata_source.note: The screenshots in this dataset serve as the v2 sanity baseline for verifying MHTML rehydration isn't systematically biased. They are not the primary metric input as of v3.

pathological_ui_filter.rationale: On high-N same-type distractor pools (calendars with 250+ near-identical <td> cells, time-slot grids, paginated identical list items), pixel-level target discrimination is structurally not well-posed. Rehydration drift of a few pixels flips ranks by dozens of positions. Observed on united.com action 4: v2 AUC=0.709 vs v3 AUC=0.306 on the same 262 calendar cells. Conservative cut at 50 distractors; tighter distractor-variance-based filter is a secondary analysis.
pathological_ui_filter.applies_to: primary analysis only. Secondary analyses may report these cases labelled as exploratory.

feature_congestion_path.note: Rosenholtz 2007 Feature Congestion computation. Per-channel local variance at sigma=2.5 on Oklab I/|a|/|b| decompositions of the peripheral-rendered PNG. Constants match scripts/export-saliency.js computeSaliencyMaps(). validateLive() checks the blob SHA.

pooled_stat_vector.note: 7-D vector. RGBA sampled at candidate screen-space bbox center on the peripheral-rendered PNG. Three FC channels computed over the full 1280x768 rendered frame with sigma=2.5, then normalized to [0,1] by per-frame max. surround(c) = annulus-mean over all 7 dims at the retinotopic pool radius.

pool_constants_note: Schwartz CMF e0 and Rosenholtz pool-size constants are not separate knobs — both are encoded in pipeline.cmf_a (2.78) and pipeline.ecc_scaling (0.75). Schwartz M(e) = log(1 + e/cmf_a); pool-radius schedule c[k] = cmf_a * (exp(k*0.5*scale) - 1) / fovea_deg with scale = cortical_max / maxMipLevel / (ecc_scaling / 0.75). See peripheral.frag lines 474-493, 710-714.

surround.description: Pooled-statistics window that the peripheral model itself assigns to the cortical patch subtending candidate c, given gaze g. Distinctiveness asks whether c stands out from the local-pool average specified by the model's own geometry.
